validate_config_dict_item: validate a config dict item against available attributes and collect errors for missing or wrong-typed fields
validate_form_config: validate a form configuration dict with title, instruction, sections, and submit_button attributes
validate_field_config: validate a field configuration dict with id, name, label, type, and validators attributes
validate_section_config: validate a section configuration dict with name, title, instruction, and fieldsets attributes
replace_path_to_file_with_its_content: replace a file path string with the contents of the file it points to
